description: Avikote AV 650 is a Portland cement-based spray and/or trowel applied product. Only the addition of water at the job site is required for application.
advantages: Fire Tested: Tested in accordance with Underwriters Laboratories, Inc. UL 1709 and ASTM E 119 (UL 263); investigated by UL for exterior use, and BS 476 (Part 20)
Durability: Avikote AV 650 has been tested for Bond Strength, Hardness, and other properties in accordance with API Guidelines (Publication 2218) and ASTM test procedures.
Pumping equipment - Moyno, Rotor Stator, Piston or Hydraulic
conforms to UL 1709 with corrosion inhibitors for the protection of the steel and metal lath.
notFor: Use on aluminum or other non-steel surfaces
mixing: approximately 15 litres (4 US gals) per bag
storage: The material shall be kept dry until ready for use.
